scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:push -w server && npm run db:seed -w server
scripts.render-build: npm install && npm run build -w shared && npx prisma generate --schema=server/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client && npx prisma migrate deploy --schema=server/prisma/schema.prisma
